findings.title: Past start times still labeled scheduled

findings.title: Lock metadata disagrees with the published rule
findings.detail: The official rules sentence specifies 300 seconds; explicit fixture lock_offset_sec values include 300, 360. We retain the source timestamps and never reconstruct UTC starts from countdowns.

findings.title: Quote observation is not a bookmaker publication timestamp
findings.detail: The captured moneyline responses expose prices and market versions but no confirmed price-publication timestamp. source_published_at remains null. Freshness is based on the explicit retrieval observation; this is not a guaranteed executable offer.

findings.title: Missing match-format values stay blank
findings.detail: 390 source-state records have neither best_of nor series_format confirmed by Hotspawn. Bookmaker format metadata is kept on its own quotes and does not silently fill the official fixture fields.

findings.title: Parallel models and tables are separate evidence scopes
findings.detail: The combined repository contains other sessions' rank-based, calibrated-model, secondary-source and curated tables. They are preserved and reviewed in the file/line audit, not silently certified as primary bookmaker inputs or merged into this snapshot. Any unresolved structural/source issue is reported without overwriting another owner.

findings.title: Unrelated public personal fields are not retained

The production collector retains only fixture-specific source state and allowed bookmaker event/market responses, and does not collect or republish leaderboard/account data.
